notes.title: Steam Cards and other updates
notes.content:
Hello folks!

Just wanted to let you know, that I'll add steam cards soon. 

The following features are planned for the next two weeks:

- a (manually) operated leader board for speedrunners (any%, 100% and below16%). The leader board will be posted as a pinned thread in the community hub. 

- a "bug killer" feature. If you find and report a bug, you'll get featured in the credits of the game as a bug killer. Please send your reports to Heatitup.inferno@web.de. Screenshots of the bug would be awesome as well. 

They're also plans for a completely new mode. You'll get more information on that by the end of the year. 

Spread the word and help me grow! Thanks for your support! You're the best! 

Dennis

Inferno
